verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads and @mentions beside a message are a fair axis for an email client, so this is not 'na'. The evidence pack documents only standard message operations (reply, forward, flag, categories) and standalone notes, which are adjacent features. Nothing shows side-thread comments or @mentions attached to an email, so the verdict is 'none'.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
